column1: # *** LUIS LLERENA, OWNER OF CARTS AND COACHES - and the collection is not all censuses. ***
# 20 September 2026. The third of the three Llerenas in 'Uruguay, Census Records, 1726-1858'.
# Index ark 1:1:6BR7-8DPW - which gives *** a name, a sex, and nothing else at all. ***

column2: The heading reads *** 'Padron de los propietarios de carretillas, carretas y coches, empadronados en el [8º] distrito de 18__' *** - a register of the owners of *** handcarts, wagons and coaches *** in a Montevideo district.
column3: *** CERTAIN, and it matters for how this whole collection is used. *** A collection called *** Census Records *** holds property registers too, and the index does not say which is which. *** An entry here is not evidence of residence in a census - it is evidence of owning a vehicle. ***

column2: A numbered list of owners. *** 10. Luis Llerena *** - written with the double L. Entry *** 11 is 'ydm ydm' *** (idem idem). Neighbours: 9 Pedro Daina, 12 D. Vicente Ponce, 13 D. Manl. Ocampo, 14 Ambrosio Olvega, 15 Andres Palom-.
column3: *** THE NAME IS SECURE. *** The 'idem' on line 11 is how these lists repeat an owner for a second vehicle, so *** he may hold two ***, and that is a reading rather than a fact.

column1: *** THE YEAR IS NOT SECURE, AND IS NOT BEING GUESSED ***
column2: The heading ends *** 'de 18__'. *** The first two digits are plain; *** the last two are not. *** It reads as 1841, 1842 or 1846.
column3: *** STATED AS A RANGE. *** If it falls in that range, *** Don Luis Lerena, b. 9 February 1811, would be about thirty ***, which suits a man of property. *** But no year is claimed, and the identification is not made on it. ***

*** NOT ASSERTED. *** This archive holds two candidates, as the row said: *** Don Luis Lerena (1811-1878) ***, husband of Justiniana Lenguas, and *** Luis, Sancho's son baptised 1811. *** *** The page adds no age, no household and no parents *** - it is a list of names against vehicles. *** What it does add is a kind of fact this archive has almost none of: an ordinary man's property in an ordinary year. ***
